eligibility_en: Level 8 (honours Bachelor) at 2:1 or better, physics named; Bachelor is enough. Aimed at new and recently qualified graduates, so check that your graduation date counts as recent.
note: You would rotate through three areas of Ireland's electricity transmission system operator over two years (or take a non-rotational specialist track), working on preparing the grid for up to 80% renewables; the job is permanent after a successful review. EirGrid hires internationals: EirGrid Public Limited Company is on the Irish Department of Enterprise list 'Employment permits issued to companies 2026'. Working language is English. The two quoted lines are the degree sentence and the discipline-list entry. Apply with a CV, cover letter and a per-subject breakdown of your results via EirGrid's portal (linked from eirgrid.ie) by 30 October 2026. Live on the employer page on 2026-10-16.

title: Commercial analyst, power for data centres and industrials
eligibility_quote_de: Quantitative degree - economics, engineering, finance, maths, physics - or equivalent experience.
eligibility_en: Quantitative degree, physics named; no level stated, so a Bachelor is enough. Asks 2–5 years in a numerate commercial role (minimum 2, below the 3-year line), plus financial modelling and GB/European power-market knowledge.
note: You would own the project models (generation, BESS, flexible load, network costs, IRR) and price first-of-a-kind power deals for data centres and large industrials, including valuing storage and flexibility across wholesale, balancing and capacity markets. Octopus hires internationals: Octopus Energy Limited (London) is on the UK Home Office register of licensed sponsors (Skilled Worker); the ad does not exclude sponsorship. Working language English. It is a fixed-term contract and the 2–5 years of commercial experience is the weakest point for you; apply via the Lever page. Live on the employer page on 2026-10-16.

title: Quantum R&D Measurement Engineer
eligibility_quote_de: BSc or MSc in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (a PhD is a plus).
eligibility_en: Bachelor's or Master's in Physics or Electrical Engineering; PhD only a plus. No minimum years stated, but they want hands-on experience with RF lab equipment and cryogenic measurement setups (academic experience counts).
note: You would run DC, RF and microwave characterisation measurements on test structures and quantum processors, at room temperature and cryogenic temperatures, and maintain the lab setups. International hiring: QuantWare B.V. is on the IND public register of recognised sponsors (Netherlands). The ad asks for no Dutch, and the team works in English. No years of experience required; apply through the Ashby form. Live on the employer page on 2026-10-16.

title: EUV System Qualification Test Engineer
eligibility_quote_de: Or a Bachelor Degree in electronics, applied physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering or other relevant fields, preferably with 1 - 3 years of experience.
eligibility_en: Bachelor's in applied physics (or electronics/EE/mechatronics); 1-3 years of experience only preferred, and the job header says 0-1 year.
salary: 51,000-57,000 EUR per year fixed (includes holiday allowance and 13th month), plus shift allowance
note: Top pick for testing: applied physics Bachelor, the job header says 0-1 year of experience, and the salary is stated. You would adjust, test and qualify EUV lithography (sub)systems against their specifications in the cleanroom, and record the measurement data in protocols and databases. International hiring: ASML Netherlands B.V. is on the IND public register of recognised sponsors. The ad asks for English and/or Dutch, so English alone is enough. It is a 5-shift job with night shifts. Access to US export-controlled technology is required, which can depend on your nationality. Apply on the ASML site with your CV and a motivation letter. Live on the employer page on 2026-10-16.

title: MEMS Development & Production Engineer (test setups)
city: Delft, Netherlands (listed as Hoofddorp / Eindhoven / Nijmegen)
eligibility_quote_de: Degree in Physics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field
eligibility_en: Degree in Physics (no level stated); posted as a New College Grad role. They want experience with MEMS, cleanroom processes and testing.
note: You would join a small team at the Delft site that prototypes MEMS modules and develops and automates their test setups. Depending on your strengths you lean toward test development or toward production workflows. International hiring: Applied Materials Europe B.V. is on the IND public register of recognised sponsors. The ad says 'Relocation Eligible: No', so expect no moving package. Fluent English is required and Dutch is a plus. There is no years requirement (New College Grad). Apply via Workday. Live on the employer page on 2026-10-16.

title: Optical Engineer II (laser test & characterisation)
eligibility_quote_de: Background in optical engineering, physics, or a closely related discipline.
eligibility_en: Physics background; no degree level and no number of years stated. They want hands-on experience with laser systems, free-space optics and fibre coupling.
note: You would characterise and test laser systems and fibre-optic assemblies, support kW-class laser testing, and document test setups and results for product development. International hiring: NKT PHOTONICS A/S (CVR 10048265) is on the Danish SIRI list of certified companies (Fast-track scheme, list updated 15-10-2026). The ad names NKT Photonics as the employer. It is an English-language ad and asks for no Danish. Apply via Workday with your CV and cover letter combined in one file. Live on the employer page on 2026-10-16.
